## What it does — the source's own header, verbatim

```
no_tab_pause.dll — keep F1 Challenge running when the window loses focus
(alt-tab / click-away). Doesn't touch game internals or any offset: it
subclasses the game's own WndProc and rewrites the OS focus-change
messages so the game always believes it's still the foreground app.

Mechanism: WM_ACTIVATEAPP's wParam (TRUE=activating/FALSE=deactivating)
and WM_ACTIVATE's low word (WA_INACTIVE=0) are what most DirectX-era
games check to decide "should I pause/throttle". Force both to "active"
before forwarding to the original proc.
```
